SELECT ih.quality_inspection_id AS qualityInspectionId, idt.quality_inspection_detail_id AS qualityInspectionDetailId, ih.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, ih.inspection_dt AS inspectionDt, u.user_nm AS inspectorName, CASE WHEN ih.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END AS status, ih.remark AS headerRemark, idt.line_no AS lineNo, idt.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ad.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, (ah.use_at = 'Y') AS arrivalLinked, c.customer_name AS supplierName, oh.order_no AS orderNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, ad.arrival_qty AS arrivalQty, idt.pass_qty + idt.fail_qty AS inspectQty, idt.pass_qty AS passQty, idt.fail_qty AS failQty, round(idt.pass_qty * 100 / (idt.pass_qty + idt.fail_qty), 1) AS passRate, idt.remark AS remark, cu.user_nm AS createdByName FROM tb_quality_inspection_hd ih JOIN tb_quality_inspection_dt idt ON idt.quality_inspection_id = ih.quality_inspection_id AND idt.tenant_id = ih.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = idt.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad ON ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id = idt.purchase_arrival_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = ah.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = ih.inspector_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account cla ON cla.login_code = ih.created_by AND cla.tenant_id = ih.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.login_id = cla.login_id AND cu.tenant_id = cla.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = idt.material_id AND m.tenant_id = idt.tenant_id WHERE ih.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND ih.use_at = 'Y'
AND ih.use_at = 'N'
AND (ih.inspection_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR idt.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND ih.inspection_no ILIKE '%' || #{inspectionNo} || '%'
AND c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{supplierKeyword} || '%'
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND idt.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{arrivalNo} || '%'
AND u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{inspectorKeyword} || '%'
AND ih.inspection_dt >= CAST(#{inspectionDtFrom} AS date)
AND ih.inspection_dt <= CAST(#{inspectionDtTo} AS date)
ORDER BY ih.inspection_dt DESC, ih.inspection_no DESC, idt.line_no
